verdict.rationale: Fellow's own features give some access to past meeting context: full transcripts are searchable for "instant access to past context," and you can ask its MCP server or Ask Fellow questions about past decisions and action items. However, nothing documents an automatic pre-meeting brief or past meetings surfaced by matching attendees. The API's attendee fields and action-item filters are only developer building blocks and earn no credit. Missing for 10: automatic surfacing of prior meetings with the same attendees, a generated pre-call brief of open threads, calendar-triggered prep, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
